_comment: Starting-point tap-zone config for the 3-page dashboard from Instructions.md, in the SAME structure/conventions as a real, working zones.json: named page paths (not index-based '/lovelace-joan/0'-style paths), a nav row of zones near the top of every page switching between the 3 pages, and (on the controls page only) additional full-width row zones calling a media_player service. The coordinates below are copied as a plausible-looking starting point from a real, physically-measured 3-page dashboard layout — they are NOT guaranteed to match your dashboard. Pixel positions depend on your exact Lovelace content, card order, and HA frontend version, so every rectangle here MUST be re-measured against your own actual device render before you trust it. Use bridge/tools/measure_zones.ps1 against a real screenshot pulled from your bridge's DEBUG_SAVE_SCREENSHOTS directory (the literal frame your physical panel actually displayed) to find the true y-boundaries, then adjust x-boundaries by reasoning about your own column layout. Also update every 'path' below to match the real Lovelace view URLs on your HA instance, and every entity_id to your own real entities.
